description: This module returns/displays a inventory details of cmms.

parameters.name: chassis
parameters.description: UUID of chassis, this is string with length greater than 16.

parameters.name: command_options
parameters.description: Options to filter nodes information. Choices: "cmms" ← (default) "cmms_by_uuid" "cmms_by_chassis_uuid"

parameters.name: login_password
parameters.description: The password for use in HTTP basic authentication.

parameters.name: login_user
parameters.description: The username for use in HTTP basic authentication.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: UUID of device, this is string with length greater than 16.

examples:
# get all cmms info
- name: Get nodes data from LXCA
  community.general.lxca_cmms:
    login_user: USERID
    login_password: Password
    auth_url: "https://10.243.15.168"

# get specific cmms info by uuid
- name: Get nodes data from LXCA
  community.general.lxca_cmms:
    login_user: USERID
    login_password: Password
    auth_url: "https://10.243.15.168"
    uuid: "3C737AA5E31640CE949B10C129A8B01F"
    command_options: cmms_by_uuid

# get specific cmms info by chassis uuid
- name: Get nodes data from LXCA
  community.general.lxca_cmms:
    login_user: USERID
    login_password: Password
    auth_url: "https://10.243.15.168"
    chassis: "3C737AA5E31640CE949B10C129A8B01F"
    command_options: cmms_by_chassis_uuid

return_values.name: result
return_values.description: Cmms detail from lxca. Returned: success Sample: {"cmmList": [{"machineType": "", "model": "", "type": "CMM", "uuid": "118D2C88C8FD11E4947B6EAE8B4BDCDF"}, {"machineType": "", "model": "", "type": "CMM", "uuid": "223D2C88C8FD11E4947B6EAE8B4BDCDF"}]}
